card.name: Verbs before up, out, into, of
card.fires_on: Verbs like turned, broken, pointed, linked or wrapped, and the word of in 'center of', that sit just before a small particle such as up, out, into or with. Seen in older, formal English prose.

modes.label: Phrasal verb start
modes.description: A verb that is about to take a particle such as up, out or into.
modes.example: they have to be limbered up,<< broken>> up, colloquialized and turned into

modes.label: Pointed or pointing out
modes.description: The verb point just before out or to.
modes.example: who<< pointed>> out163 that its level corresponds

modes.label: Linking phrase
modes.description: A passive verb or a noun plus of that leads into a relation or focus.

card.plain: It fires on a verb that is waiting for a small word like up, out or into to finish the phrase.
